verdict.rationale: Galileo documents instrumenting LangChain and LangGraph apps, with traces streamed to Galileo, including an OpenTelemetry/OpenInference path for LangGraph. Its docs also claim it works with all major LLM providers and agentic frameworks, and the quickstart covers OpenAI in Python and TypeScript. missing for 10: explicit Vercel AI SDK integration, a dedicated OpenAI SDK wrapper/integration page (the quickstart only implies one), framework integration reference docs beyond cookbooks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
